description: M5b partitioned nested-sampling (dynesty) posteriors on synthetic data (Horizons Uranus incl. real Neptune + noise; noise_free: the true longitudes). Intervals are 16/50/84 % marginal percentiles of the combined posterior; the 1846 longitude is the perturber's light-time-corrected geocentric ecliptic-of-date longitude on 1846-09-23. e also carries one-sided 68 / 95 % upper limits and its prior median (a central interval excludes a truth on the e = 0 boundary by construction). ln Z errors are dynesty's quoted errors × err_inflation (measured on seed 0). Raw runs are not committed (data/cache/nested/m5b/).

priors.uranus: box ±50 scaled σ around the Uranus-only fit

profile_m5a: per dataset: M5a profile Δχ² ≤ 1 intervals (site/data/m5a_profile.json) where that dataset was profiled, else null

e.note: e ≥ 0 and the true e sits on that boundary: a central 68 % interval excludes a boundary truth by construction, so the one-sided upper limits are the check that applies. The posterior median against the prior median (uniform e) shows how weakly e is constrained.
